Nalla Padam follows the life of Kumaran, whose life revolves around alcohol. Despite the support of his mother and the efforts of his sister Amutha and his girlfriend to change him, Kumaran remains deeply trapped in his drinking habits.

His life takes an unexpected turn when alcohol is banned in India. What follows is a journey exploring his life, relationships, addiction and the changes that unfold around him. The film blends humour, romance, sentiment and social commentary. Nallapadam.
